transcript: What are paid ads? In five words, guaranteed eyeballs for your stuff. So break that down a little bit more. So I think when it comes to. To marketing in general, people who are familiar with paid ads, what you're getting by being willing to pay, you are guaranteeing the people are gonna see your stuff. That's the biggest thing, I think, in a world of putting so much emphasis on organic content, a lot of business owners, marketers have the experience of putting a ton of time and effort into making content, making stuff to try and sell products and services, and just basically no one sees it. Very competitive landscape. If you are willing to pay, you can guarantee people see it. Now, there's no guarantee of results. Your ads have to be good, your offers have to be good, but you can guarantee people see it. And that's a huge part of the battle when it comes to marketing.
